title: The subsheaf of sections annihilated by a quasi-coherent ideal of finite type
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of finite type and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ put $\mathcal F'(U)=\{s\in\mathcal F(U):\ a\,s|_V=0\text{ for every open }V\subseteq U\text{ and every }a\in\mathcal I(V)\}$. Then $\mathcal F'$ is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module of $\mathcal F$ (the *subsheaf of sections annihilated by* $\mathcal I$), and: (1) $\mathcal F'$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module; (2) for every affine open $U\subseteq X$, $\mathcal F'(U)=\{s\in\mathcal F(U):\ a s=0\text{ for all }a\in\mathcal I(U)\}$; (3) for every $x\in X$, identifying $\mathcal F'_x$ with a submodule of $\mathcal F_x$ and $\mathcal I_x$ with an ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ through the (injective) stalk maps of the inclusions [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], $\mathcal F'_x=\{s\in\mathcal F_x:\ a s=0\text{ for all }a\in\mathcal I_x\}$.

proof.text: For the forward stalk-image implication, represent a preimage by a germ on V. Restrict an ideal section on U to U intersect V using naturality of the ideal inclusion. The sectionwise image formula makes its product with the restricted image section zero. Germ compatibility with restriction, scalar multiplication, and the stalk map gives the required zero product.

proof.text: For the reverse stalk implication, annihilator_stalk_local_lift gives a locally annihilated section representing the desired germ. The image formula lifts this section through the inclusion; its germ maps to the original stalk element.

lean.statement: theorem sections_annihilated_by_ideal (X : Scheme.{u}) (J : X.IdealSheafData) [J.toModules.IsFiniteType] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] : ∃ (G : X.Modules) (ι : G ⟶ F), Mono ι ∧ G.IsQuasicoherent ∧ (∀ (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(F, U)), s ∈ Set.range (ι.app U) ↔ ∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U), ∀ a ∈ J.idealOfOpens V, a • F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s = 0) ∧ (∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(F, U.1)), s ∈ Set.range (ι.app U.1) ↔ ∀ a ∈ J.ideal U, a • s = 0) ∧ (∀ x : X, Function.Injective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map J.toModulesι).hom ∧ Function.Injective ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom ∧ ∀ s : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F, s ∈ Set.range ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom ↔ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U), ∀ a ∈ J.idealOfOpens U, X.presheaf.germ U x hx a • s = 0)
